fato_historico: 1980: Vigdís Finnbogadóttir is elected President of Iceland and becomes the world's first democratically elected female head of state.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to step into your own authority today. Much like a pioneer breaking glass ceilings in the chilly North, you may find that your emotional intuition is the strongest tool in your arsenal. It is a good time to trust your inner compass and lead your heart toward new, bold horizons.
frase_do_dia: Your intuition is the crown you wear every single day.
significado_numero: The number of new beginnings and individual leadership.
conselho: Stand tall, trust your gut, and honor the pioneer within you.
